compiled_state.title: [tests/scripts/test-test-batched.sh]: test_interrupted_node_test_reruns_on_resume flakes intermittently in CI -> blocks merge despite no code change
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

### Scenario Type
P3 — CI flake.

### Expected Behavior
`test-test-batched.sh::test_interrupted_node_test_reruns_on_resume` should pass deterministically in CI. It verifies that when a node test is interrupted, the resume path correctly re-runs it and records the prior interrupted result in state.

### Actual Behavior
Observed on 2026-05-18, PR #211 (final batch-6 remediation of 1624-5fb9):

```
[364/486] test-test-batched.sh ... FAIL (83 pass, 1 fail)
75:FAIL: test_interrupted_node_test_reruns_on_resume: state records interrupted result
78:FAIL: test_interrupted_node_test_reruns_on_resume
```

83/84 tests in the file pass; only this one fails. The diff under review (final batch-6 remediation) touched none of:
- tests/scripts/test-test-batched.sh
- plugins/dso/scripts/test-batched.sh
- any other test-runner-state-related file

So the failure is unrelated to the PR's content — it's an intermittent CI race.

### Hypothesis
Likely a similar state-file or timing race to the test-merge-to-main.sh flake (bug aa4f-13b3). The test asserts "state records interrupted result" — i.e., it expects to read a state artifact that may have been written, deleted, or partially synced by a concurrent worker before the read.

### Reproduction
Hard to reproduce locally (passes ~100% locally). CI-only flake under suite-engine parallelization.

### Suggested Fix Directions
1. Audit test-test-batched.sh::test_interrupted_node_test_reruns_on_resume for shared-state usage (any /tmp or repo-scoped state files used across processes).
2. If the test uses temporary state, ensure paths are per-process unique (mktemp-d rather than fixed names).
3. Add an mtime-based debounce or retry if the state-write timing is racing the assertion.

### Skills and Workflows
- Affected file: tests/scripts/test-test-batched.sh
- Tested file: plugins/dso/scripts/test-batched.sh (or wherever interrupt-resume logic lives)
- Related flake bug: aa4f-13b3 (test-merge-to-main.sh state-file race)
- Pattern family: CI test infrastructure flake from shared-state assumptions

comments.body: Cluster Investigation Mode: invoked as cluster /dso:fix-bug 53f9-a218 42bd-5b9b 6aeb-5593 aa4f-13b3. Max-of-tier score=6 → ADVANCED. Investigating all four as a single problem before deciding single-fix vs split-fix.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Cluster investigation — Track B (INDEPENDENT root cause): NOT a state-file race. test-test-batched.sh uses mktemp -d for every fixture and a hashed git-root namespace (test-batched.sh:202–213), fully isolated from /tmp/merge-to-main-state-*. The test_interrupted_node_test_reruns_on_resume flake is timing-dependent: --timeout=1s on a node setInterval test may be killed BEFORE the harness records 'interrupted' under heavy CI load. Recommended fix: bump first-run timeout from 1s to 3s, OR add a 100ms sleep-retry loop checking for non-empty state (same pattern as test-merge-to-main.sh:606-618). Confidence: medium (root cause inferred from isolation evidence; runtime profiling would confirm).
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Reverted to open: investigation Track B (independent of Track A's state-file race). Fix pending — requires bumping --timeout from 1s to 3s OR adding retry-loop pattern. Not landed in PR #221.
